location: 2442 Riopelle between Winder. and E. Fisher Service Drive in an M3 (Zone General Industrial District)
legal_description: E RIOPELLE Q & P SUB OF RIOPELLE FARM L1 P135 PLATS,WCR 7/26 67.20 X 130
proposal: Yi Ping Ho is requesting dimensional variances to establish the use of a High-Impact Manufacturing or Processing ("Meat processing facility) in an existing two-story, 14,196 sq. foot bldg. Approved by BSEED in SLU2022-00067: Decision Date: July 28, 2022 – Effective Date: August 11, 2022. The subject site is within an M3 Zone General Industrial District. The Board shall be authorized to hear dimensional variance requests for matters that are beyond the scope of BSEED’s 10% administrative adjustments for a variance of the minimum setbacks. A total of one hundred and three off-street parking spaces are required. The subject site is located within ½ mile of a High Frequency Transit Corridor, (Gratiot), BSEED can reduce the off-street parking requirement by twenty-five percent or seventy-seven required off- street parking spaces. Zero off-street parking spaces are being proposed by the applicant. As the applicant is unable to provide off-street parking within one hundred radial feet of the subject site, a parking variance shall be required from the Board of Zoning Appeals prior to issuance of a building permit. (Sections 50-4-131 (1)- Permitted dimensional variances and 50-4-121 Approval Criteria.)AP
action: Ms. Teague made a motion to Dismiss case with fee due to change in the ordinance that petitioner no longer needs a parking variance at this location. Seconded by Board Member Walker.

proposal: Kevin Adkins is requesting dimensional variances to construct 2 structures (carriage house and four seasons room) on zoning lot of subject property within a R1 Single-Family Residential District. The Board shall be authorized to hear dimensional variance requests for matters that are beyond the scope of BSEED’s 10% administrative adjustments for a variance of the minimum setbacks. action: Mr. Watson made a motion to Deny dimensional variances construct 2 structures (carriage house and four seasons room) on zoning lot of subject property within a R1 Single-Family Residential District. Seconded by Board Member Weed.

location: 16750 Telegraph between Dehner and McNichols in a B4 (General Business District)
legal_description: E TELEGRAPH 17 EXC E 150 FT RIVERDALE PARK SUB L33 P77 PLATS, W C R 22/472 135.7 IRREG
proposal: Wehasit, LLC appeals the decision of the Buildings Safety and Engineering and Environmental Department (BSEED PIN: 22122517-8) which DENIED the establishment of a Marijuana Retail/Provisioning Facility in a B4 General Business District. The Board of Zoning Appeals shall hear and decide appeals from and review any order, requirement, decision, or determination that is made by an administrative official in the administration of this Zoning Ordinance, or any decision made by the Buildings and Safety Engineering Department involving Conditional Uses, Regulated Uses, or Controlled Uses, or any denial of a site plan by the Planning and Development Department; after review of the submitted plans, a spacing analysis has been determined that the proposed Marijuana Retail/Provisioning Facility is located within 1000 radial feet of a Marijuana Retail/Provisioning Facility at 16890 Telegraph (421 feet) which was approved by BSEED on June 17, 2022. (Sec. 50-3-535. - Permitted districts for medical marihuana facilities; conditional use; restrictions: (b)A medical marihuana caregiver center or medical marihuana provisioning center facility must not be located in any of the following: (3) On a zoning lot that is located less than: b. One thousand radial feet from any zoning lot with an unexpired conditional land use approval, building permit, or Certificate of Occupancy for a medical marihuana caregiver center or medical marihuana provisioning center facility; (d)Neither the Buildings, Safety Engineering, and Environmental Department, nor the Board of Zoning Appeals is authorized to waive or modify the locational specifications set forth in Subsections (b)(1), (b)(2), (b)(3), and (c) of this section. Applications that are not consistent with the locational specifications of Subsections (b)(1), (b)(2), (b)(3), and (c) of this section, which may be confirmed by the City Engineer, shall be considered ineligible for further processing, and shall be denied.) (Sections 50-4-101 Jurisdiction Over Appeals of Administrative Decisions, 50-4-102. Appeals, 50-3-281. General approval criteria.)AP
action: Ms. Moore made a motion to Uphold BSEED Denial for the establishment of a Marijuana Retail/Provisioning Facility in a B4 General Business District. Seconded by Board Member Moore.
confidence_note: Mr. Watson was noted as not present for the vote.
